title: Neural population geometry and optimal coding of tasks with shared latent structure
goal: Recreate and exceed the original author-reported selected performance endpoint. Original rat PFC and CA1 500-ms spike-count prediction from navigation covariates, retaining both source regional tenfold Poisson-GLM comparisons across all eight rats and eight learning sessions per rat. Reproduce the author cross-validated deviance-explained results and compare candidate predictions on the identical original data, covariates, folds and regional reductions. Geometry, optimal coding and behavioural readout findings remain separately named reproduction.
primary_outputs: Selected reproduction: source-native computation and complete original performance findings, with the source reference and agreement criteria independently qualified.
Selected improvement: candidate performance against strongest relevant original author comparator on identical original support; all required conditions and companions remain mandatory.

Separately retained biological reproduction: Original learning-dependent CA1/PFC geometry, expected-activity covariance, optimal coding, quadratic/linear trends and behavioural readout. Preserve paper/code CA1 24-versus-19-unit geometry discrepancy and CA1 readout R² 0.48-versus-0.49 separately, without requiring these unrelated quantities as the encoding performance primary.
success_criteria: Reproduce the complete selected original endpoint from authentic source observations and independently verified derived outputs.
Exceed the strongest relevant author comparator on the same source-defined target, inputs, split and complete metric support under a justified joint comparison.
Keep reproduction and improvement independent and both assistance conditions matched except declared official source access.
No runtime, result, paper win or current-SOTA claim follows from this scope construction.
All concrete source, reference, exposure, tolerance and execution gaps in primary-endpoint-v1 remain blocking.

retained_prior_scope_holds.interpretation: Preserved source, observation, exposure and execution restrictions apply within their retained scope. Secondary or partial-component criteria cannot, alone, qualify or redefine the complete corrected primary findings; retain the exact relationship and coverage stated in retained_secondary_scope.
primary_source_limits: Exact native animal/session/bin/unit identities, movement and rate masks, session anatomy and ZT2 mapping remain unauthenticated. Archive existence and source roster declarations do not qualify the input panel.

Preserve source covariance and z-scoring conventions, raw versus fitted activity, participation-ratio and other geometric trajectories, readout/behavior pairings, and original quadratic and follow-up linear trend analyses. Six scalar summaries cannot replace this structured result.

Preserve source GLM basis and regularization selection, ten-fold behavior, both regional D2 outputs and exact fold/unit/session/rat aggregation; native outputs, null-unit treatment and boundary conventions remain unresolved.

Retain the paper/code CA1 subset discrepancy: paper Methods specifies 24 CA1 and 19 PFC units, whereas a retained code route uses 19 CA1 units. Original 500-observation subsets, 300 training observations and 500-subset averaging require authentic identities rather than a newly chosen recipe.
The primary source reports CA1 behavioral/readout R2 as 0.48 in main text and 0.49 in the Figure 7 caption. Preserve this discrepancy and unresolved source references and numerical criteria.

No justified primary superiority criterion is established. Higher D2, stronger correlations or smaller p-values alone do not improve the primary biological finding. Structured-output schema limitations do not justify replacing the finding with a scalar diagnostic.

No explicit task-specific authority to replace the retained family with D2 alone was found in the bounded inspected records. A supplied reviewed named-result revision must be evaluated on its actual terms; actively choosing D2 as sole primary is a new scope decision.

The mixed primary-geometry reproduction and D2-only improvement bundle remains unavailable if the schema cannot faithfully express the distinction. This does not invalidate the useful empirical D2 source components.

holds.interpretation: Prior holds retain their historical scope and evidence. They do not silently override this explicit selected original endpoint; unchanged source/runtime/uncertainty limits still block qualification.
